breakdown.description: A 2D simulation requires the front and back patches to be of type 'empty' to remove their influence, but they are incorrectly set to 'wall', which makes the simulation 3D with frictional side walls.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect 'wall' type for the frontAndBack patch in blockMeshDict, uses 'noSlip' for frontAndBack in 0/U, and 'zeroGradient' for frontAndBack in 0/p. The ground truth requires all of these to be 'empty' for a proper 2D simulation. The agent repeated the original error on all three counts.
